relevance_note: Case series with per-patient tables of 17 HA20 patients: '17 patients from 6 families with heterozygous likely loss-of-function variants in TNFAIP3'.
method_note: Main per-patient source is Supplementary File 1 (patients as rows; columns Family, Variant, ACMG class, Pt, Age at analysis, Age at onset, feature columns, IS, CXCL9, CXCL10, PGA, CRP) and Supplementary File 3 (ANA, other autoimmune labs, treatments). A Python script parsed these tables; each family row holds stacked cells (' / '). Values were assigned to patients only when the number of stacked values equalled the number of patients in the row; otherwise the item is not reported for each of them (e.g. family 1 recurrent fever '+ / + / +' for 4 patients, family 6 oral aphthosis 4 values for 5 patients, single '+' cells in multi-patient rows). Script output was checked by hand against the table; column totals of '+' match Table 1 counts. '+' is read as present (no legend defines it); '-' in the other-autoimmune-labs column is undefined and treated as not reported. Labels: the paper's own text labels where used (pt1-pt4, p7, p10, pt13, p14, pt15, Pt16, pt17, verbatim, note mixed 'p'/'pt' forms); patients never labelled in the text use the bare 'Pt' number column: 'Supplementary File 1 #<n>'. Pt4, #6, #8, #11, Pt16 are marked '*parents' and #12, pt17 '**grandparents', but whose parents is shown only in a pedigree image, so relationships and inheritance are not recorded. Sex is given only at group level (Table 1). Ages in the table have no printed unit; ISO values assume years, consistent with the paper's '<5 years' onset grouping and Figure 2 '(y)'. 'Age at analysis' recorded as age at last evaluation. Zygosity heterozygous from the statement naming all 17 patients. Variant type left not reported except the exon 7-9 deletion, which the text calls a copy number variation; 'truncating variants resulting in stop codon' does not give one enum class. The deletion is called 'de novo' but parental testing results are not stated, so inheritance is not reported (rule 8); 'All but one variants were inherited' does not say which parent. Text spells 'pArg183Ter' where the table has 'p.Arg183Ter'. Derived lab features: 'elevated type 1 interferon signature' observed/excluded using the paper's positivity cut-off (>2); 'elevated CRP' observed only for CRP >=0.5 mg/dl, the paper's PGA definition of increased CRP; lower CRP values left without a row. CXCL9/10 and PGA not recorded as features. Neuropsychiatric diagnoses from the Results text; one suicide attempt (pt16 or pt17) is not attributed and not recorded; neuropsychiatric symptoms were not mapped to 'central nervous system involvement'. Table 1 group counts (e.g. Hashimoto thyroiditis 7, coeliac 4) are not attributed to anyone. SLE classification criteria excluded for all from 'none of the patients in our cohort fulfilled the classification criteria for SLE'. No internal contradictions found.
